mode: Engineering author coverage: actual local handlers/provider protocol/installed SDK fixtures; synthetic model and review proof; zero external network

checks.name: A current real request offers request permission only; quote permission requires an explicit sent-quote milestone
Signed exact-purpose initiation, accepted disclosure and later exact affirmative permit one queued outreach and canonical receipt without completing owner work
Generic YES, START and appointment permission never grant service follow-up; generic YES gets an exact neutral instruction without AI
STOP then START requires a fresh sent disclosure and distinct affirmative; old question is not revived
Lost inbound reply projection reuses the same saved question and event identity, not a new ask
Accepted question with failed proof projection recovers from its same canonical provider receipt; early stored affirmative reconciles without another ask
Wrong number, reference, purpose, signature and provider account cannot manufacture permission or a quote milestone
Provider failed disclosure never grants permission; a new recipient initiation gets a fresh fixed question
Late permission needs a new future time and cannot cause immediate stale outreach
Historical reached contact is compatible with a new plan; a new attempted contact stops it without implying a completed paid job
Any new ordinary customer reply stops unsent outreach, including same-millisecond receipt; consent controls do not count
Changed mobile/source fences old permission and quote invitation while retaining old proof audit
Saving then stopping or superseding a plan fences its queue identity; closed requests require explicit reopen
Attempted outreach consumes the one request allowance across purpose switch, new operation, close/reopen and repeated consent
Unknown provider result remains uncertain, consumes the allowance and never repeats the physical POST
Durable owner save survives enqueue failure; normal worker rebuilds exactly the same job and operation receipt
Existing appointment registration remains byte-exact and blocked for new purposes; owner review is retained once
Only explicit reviewed new registration selection persists expanded program; wrong digest, unreviewed and malformed dates are rejected
Revoked owner session, foreign owner and cancelled workspace cannot prepare; cancelled history stays readable
Concurrent owner plans from one revision retain one winner and a recoverable exact receipt; another body cannot reuse its operation
Final durable allowance reservation followed by STOP, pause, source correction, gate withdrawal or budget withdrawal produces no provider POST
Quiet hours, closed platform gate and absent sending budget retain the same unsent job rather than claiming delivery
Unknown disclosure is not resent to obtain permission; its existing accepted SID can be reconciled by a verified callback
Explicit expanded public program matches real question/START and carrier field sizes; default and legacy policy remain distinct
Actual public chat saves a real request and returns only an optional current-recipient invitation; no SMS, consent or quote promise is created
Engineering regression from independent QA: a canonical failed disclosure callback received before a late accepted POST response cannot revive permission or send outreach
